༄༅/ /lam 'bras a seng don bsdus zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༈/na mo gu ru birwa pā ya/rje btsun rin chen dam pa'i gsung gang zhig/mun bral zla shar 'od

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam 'bras a seng don bsdus zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru birwa pā ya/ rje btsun rin chen dam pa'i gsung gang zhig /mun bral zla shar 'od zer gang zhig gis// bdag lta blo yi mun pa bral gyur nas// rang gi sems la snang ba cung zad thob// grogs mchog dam pa thos pa'i rgyud sbyangs shing*// byang chub ched du sgrub pa'i go bgos nas// dam pa'i spyan sngar lung mnos dam bcas pa// mi mchog khyod kyi bka' stsal lci bar gyur// thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' ni rgya mtsho bzhin// zab cing gting dpag dka' la thug pa med// rdo rje theg pa dgongs pa du ma yis// gsungs shing rdo rje'i tshig gis rgyas btab pas// lung bstan gyur pa klu sgrub la sogs sam// mkha' 'gros byin rlabs birwa pa la sogs// grub thob rnams kyi gdams ngag la brten nas// rjes 'jug skye bo'i bka' rnams rtogs par 'gyur// don gyi gtso bo birwa la sogs pa'i// lam gyi gsung ngag khyed kyi thugs la mnga'// 'on kyang bka' 'phrin mi 'gog pa yi phyir// rang blo las byung 'di tsam yi ger bkod// snang ba gsum gyi lam gyis gzhi bcas te// nyams blang ma lus rgyud gsum dag gis shes// tshad ma snyan rgyud bzhi yis spros pa gcod// rten 'brel lnga yis lam gyi sa mtshams gcod// 'du lugs gsum dang phyogs med bdun dag gis// rnam par phye bas sgro skur bral bar mdzod// sems 'dzin gnas lugs rnam gsum rtogs pa yis// ting nge 'dzin gyi nye rgyu rtogs par bya// rang lus dag la nyams gsum skye ba yis// gang yang ting nge 'dzin du mkhyen par mdzod// drod gsum rim pa yin min skye ba yis// gang yin byung rgyal dag tu btang bar mdzod// ded dpon lta bu'i khrid lugs rnam gsum gyis// ting 'dzin nyams kyi bye brag rtogs par mdzod// 'dus ba gsum la dpe gsum sbyar ba yis// lam gyi sa mtshams the tshom med par mdzod// rten 'brel rnam gsum rang la 'dzom pa yis// rgyu rkyen gzhan med re dogs bral bar mdzod// thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug rnal 'byor pa// gnyis la bar chad 'jug ste gcig la min// bsrung ba brgyad brgyad bcu drug dag tu ste// thabs la dad pa la sogs rnam pa brgyad// shes rab sad pa rnam pa bzhi yis bsrung*// nang gi bdud la dbang bzhi'i brda yis bzlogs// gnyis la thun mong bsrung ba bcu bzhi ste// dang po lam du 'jug dang zhugs pa dang*// sems 'dzin cung zad brtan dang cher brtan pa'i// bar chad rim gyis sel ba shes par bya// rtsa yi zug la la dor shin tu gces// rlung gi zug la rngan dgas byin te bzlog

/rlung rid pa la la dor byin rlabs dang*// bde ba sgom dang rnam pa gsum du gsungs// lta sgom gnyis la dug dbyung bdud rtsi bsten// la dor man ngag drug tu shes par bya// thig le 'bar dang g.yo dang brtan pa dang*// rnam gsum dag gis bde stong mchog tu 'gyur// 'bar ba'i tshe na thig le'i zug 'byung ste// kha sbyar dag la brtan par 'gyur ba dang*// dud 'gro'i 'gyur ba bzhi yis bzlog pa yis// lus las thig le g.yo ba med par bya// kun tu khyab cing brten par bya ba'i phyir// lus la btun shing 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// yan lag bzhi yis rlung gi zhags pa 'phang*// bu chung spyod lam dag gis brtan par 'gyur// rje btsun dpal ldan birwa pa yi gzhung*// dbang bzhi'i lam la lta grub brgyad kyis bsdus// skyon rnams yon tan dag tu blang ba dang*// bar chad dngos grub dag tu blang bar gyis// gang yang nyams kyi snang bar mkhyen bgyis na// bdud dang gol sa rang grol dag tu 'gyur// the tshom med par brtson pa cher mdzad na// grub mtha' snyogs par 'gyur ro mi mchog khyod// bdag lta 'du ba'i nang zhugs nas// sgrub la dad kyang lhod par gyur// rje btsun birwa pa yi gzhung*// yi ger bkod pa dag kyang med// rang gi sems la snang ba tsam// bkod na dam pa'i bka' las 'das// grogs kyi bka' stsal bcag gyur kyang*// mkha' 'gros dpang mdzod bzod par gsol// rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa chen po la/ mdo smad kyi dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa byang chub sems dpa' a seng gis zhus te don bsdus pa 'di mdzad do// //sa māpta i thī// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
